_note: 2_S04 'Character Sheets' — Melvin's side mission: four character sheets held by bullies at four spots around the school grounds; KO each stash guard, collect all four, return them to Melvin at the library (recon: docs/re-notes/ch1/2_S04-character-sheets.md). Engine evidence places it at the Ch1->2 boundary (SMissPass F_LaunchingMission fires the Chapt1Trans dependency on launch), so the campaign table lists it as chapter-2-onset even though fan canon calls it a chapter-1 side mission — contradiction flagged in the recon. v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the sheets collect in a fixed order (the original is any-order with four concurrent monitors); each stash is one hostile guard at the guard point instead of its bespoke encounter (sheet 1's rochambeau duel, sheet 2's Thad-ally ambush and health-nerd soda drop, sheet 3's Bucky tease scene, sheet 4's fleeing-smoker chase legs with marble drops are all skipped — those need qte_duel/recruit_ally/bark_dialog_loop/flee_loop primitives that do not exist yet); the HUD charasheet counter and objective checklist are the objective line only (collect_counter/checklist pending); Melvin's ambient-population suppression swap is skipped (no unique_ped_suppress primitive); the boys'-dorm trophy is pending (no trophy system). Guard meshes stand in for the original peds: sheet1 ped 85 GN_Bully03, sheet2 ped 99 GN_Bully02, sheet3 ped 102 GN_Bully01, sheet4 ped 99 GN_Bully02. Pass pays $10 via the campaign on_pass (M_PASS 1000 cents). Wording is original.
title: Character Sheets

on_start.sub: Melvin's life's work, scattered to the bullies.

lines.speaker: MELVIN
lines.text: My character sheets! The bullies took all four of them. Get them back and I'll make it worth your while.
